extracted.name: Herby White Bean Spread
extracted.description: This herby white bean spread is a delicious appetizer or snack! I love to serve it with crisp Lundberg Organic Brown Rice Thin Stackers and fresh veggie toppings like carrots and radishes.
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cups cooked cannellini beans (drained and rinsed)
1/4 cup mixed fresh herbs (dill, tarragon, mint, and/or chives)
1/2 teaspoon sea salt (plus more to taste)
Lundberg Organic Brown Rice Thin Stackers
instruction_lines: In a food processor, place the cannellini beans, herbs, olive oil, lemon juice, tahini, garlic, lemon zest, salt, and several grinds of pepper. Pulse until creamy. If the mixture is too thick, add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until it reaches a creamy consistency.
Assemble each thin stacker with the spread, radishes, carrots, edamame, herbs, and a sprinkle of feta cheese.
